The main takeaway from our work is that

the trace norm regularization technique, combined with new ARM kernel implementations, enables the training and inference of large neural networks for embedded speech recognition with significantly fewer parameters, faster training and faster inference than previously reported.

the trace norm can be used to train low rank matrix multiplications in neural networks, which leads to faster inference and can be used in conjunction with standard techniques such as weight pruning and quantization.
the combination of trace norm regularization for compression and ARM kernel optimization for speedup is a powerful tool for improving the trade-offs in embedded neural network design.
